QuestInfo.name: [Murgoth Dungeon Season 3] Beauty and the Beast
QuestInfo.0: Murgoth appeared out of nowhere and is asking for your help. Go see what the problem is.\r\n\r\n#rThis event quest is available until 23:59 on 10/31/2017.#k
QuestInfo.1: Murgoth teleported you to his location. He is standing next to a lady you've never seen before. Talk to Murgoth and figure out what's going on.\r\n\r\n#rThis event quest is available until 23:59 on 10/31/2017.#k
QuestInfo.2: Murgoth doesn't go into detail but simply asks you to bring his soul, which he's been storing in the Otherworld, back to him. Seems like he wants to make a gift of it to this lady. You tell him that you'll make the trip to the Otherworld.\r\n\r\n#rThis event quest is available until 23:59 on 10/31/2017.#k
